# Opero Docs

> Documentation for Opero product concepts, integrations, API tokens, and API workflows.

These docs describe public Opero concepts and the external Opero API. English is the primary index. Polish documentation is available under `https://kodasoft.pl/docs/pl`.

## Start Here

- [Welcome](https://kodasoft.pl/docs/en): Overview of Opero docs and the recommended reading path.
- [Getting Started](https://kodasoft.pl/docs/en/getting-started): Find the API base URL, prepare an API token, and make a first request.

## API Essentials

- [API Overview](https://kodasoft.pl/docs/en/api): Entry point for Opero API documentation.
- [Authentication](https://kodasoft.pl/docs/en/api/authentication): Use Opero API tokens with bearer authentication.
- [Language](https://kodasoft.pl/docs/en/api/language): Request localized API responses with the Accept-Language header.
- [OpenAPI](https://kodasoft.pl/docs/en/api/open-api): Use the current OpenAPI schema with API tools and client generators.

## Product Context

- [Opero](https://kodasoft.pl/docs/en/opero): Browse product documentation generated from public Opero documentation records.
- [Record Lists](https://kodasoft.pl/docs/en/opero/04-listy-rekordow/lista-rekordow): Record lists, list views, search, filtering, and export.
- [Automation](https://kodasoft.pl/docs/en/opero/07-automatyzacja/reguly-wprowadzenie): Automation rules, triggers, actions, notifications, and custom scripts.

## Extensions

- [Extensions](https://kodasoft.pl/docs/en/extensions): Build Opero integrations as extension packages: a connection, rule steps and template filters, the package's own objects, dictionaries and queries, triggers raised on a schedule, and per-member connections, installed without deploying code.
- [Tutorial: build Hello](https://kodasoft.pl/docs/en/extensions/tutorial/start-the-package): Scaffold, write, test, pack, upload and install a complete extension.
- [Recipe: a package with its own data](https://kodasoft.pl/docs/en/extensions/own-data): An object with a dictionary-backed field, a saved query, and a step that fetches, calls a service and writes back, tested with effects.
- [Recipe: events from a service](https://kodasoft.pl/docs/en/extensions/scheduled-events): A trigger, a schedule that reads a service and raises an event for each changed item with dedupe, a rule that listens, and the same for each connected member.
- [Start from your organization](https://kodasoft.pl/docs/en/extensions/start-from-your-organization): Export an organization's own dictionaries, objects, saved queries, template filters and Custom Blocks as a package folder with opero-ext pull, then finish, test and install it elsewhere.
- [Command-line tool](https://kodasoft.pl/docs/en/extensions/reference/cli): opero-ext: install and update, sign-in, every command, consent for install and upgrade, --json output and exit codes.
- [extension.yaml](https://kodasoft.pl/docs/en/extensions/reference/manifest): The extension manifest: key, version, network and data permissions, connection, settings and feature lists.
- [Settings](https://kodasoft.pl/docs/en/extensions/reference/settings): The extension's own settings in settings.yaml: groups, defaults, required settings, reading them in rules and scripts, tests and upgrades.
- [Connection and secrets](https://kodasoft.pl/docs/en/extensions/reference/connection-and-secrets): Credentials, verification, organization or company scopes, HTTP Basic with auth: connection, and where a secret may appear.
- [Member connections](https://kodasoft.pl/docs/en/extensions/reference/member-connections): connection/member.yaml: each member connects their own account by OAuth, the member's form, afterConnect and beforeDisconnect, {{ userConnection.<field> }} in member actions, refused tokens and reconsent.
- [Objects](https://kodasoft.pl/docs/en/extensions/reference/objects): object.yaml: the package's own objects and fields in the x-<key> module, references to its dictionaries and objects, upgrades and uninstalling.
- [Dictionaries](https://kodasoft.pl/docs/en/extensions/reference/dictionaries): dictionary.yaml: entries, the installed key x-<key>-<name>, select fields, translated entry labels.
- [Queries](https://kodasoft.pl/docs/en/extensions/reference/queries): query.yaml and its SQL file: {{object.<key>}} placeholders, FETCH and MUTATION, parameters, the installed key x_<key_snake>_<name>.
- [Data permissions](https://kodasoft.pl/docs/en/extensions/reference/data-permissions): permissions.data: the eight data scopes, what each step may name, the owner-only install, and when it is checked.
- [Data steps](https://kodasoft.pl/docs/en/extensions/reference/data-steps): Fetch, create and update records, run queries, update contractors, send email and notifications and generate documents from a rule file, each with its test.
- [Triggers](https://kodasoft.pl/docs/en/extensions/reference/triggers): trigger.yaml: the rule trigger x-<key>.<trigger>, its event data, filters, example and dedupe retention, and how it behaves while the extension is not running.
- [Raising events](https://kodasoft.pl/docs/en/extensions/reference/raising-events): The EMIT_EVENT step: items, keys, dedupe and unchanged items, limits, where it may be used, and at-least-once delivery.
- [Schedules](https://kodasoft.pl/docs/en/extensions/reference/schedules): schedule.yaml: an action run every 15 minutes to 24 hours once, for each company or for each connected member, its input, outcomes, retries and parking.
- [After install](https://kodasoft.pl/docs/en/extensions/after-install): What the administrator sees: the install and upgrade plan, states, settings, installed data, schedules and connected members, failed steps, upgrades that delete data, and uninstalling with or without the data.
- [Error codes](https://kodasoft.pl/docs/en/extensions/error-codes): Every code reported when a package is refused, its tests fail, the install plan finds a problem, a step, an event or a schedule run fails, a member's connection fails, or an administrator's command is refused.

## API Resource Guides

- [Contractors](https://kodasoft.pl/docs/en/api/companies/get-companies-companyid-contractors): Work with contractors, suppliers, customers, and other business partners.
- [Service Catalog](https://kodasoft.pl/docs/en/api/companies/get-companies-companyid-service-catalog-items): Manage reusable services, goods, and bundles.
- [Custom Modules](https://kodasoft.pl/docs/en/api/custom-modules/list-custom-modules): List and manage custom module definitions.
- [Custom Objects](https://kodasoft.pl/docs/en/api/custom-objects/list-custom-objects): Work with custom object schemas and records.
- [Rules](https://kodasoft.pl/docs/en/api/rules/introduction): Manage and run Opero automation rules.
- [View Layout Configuration](https://kodasoft.pl/docs/en/api/view-layout-configuration/overview): Build and publish View Layouts for Opero records and forms.
- [View Layout Runtime](https://kodasoft.pl/docs/en/api/view-layout-runtime/runtime): Resolve published View Layouts, load runtime data, and save records.
- [Files](https://kodasoft.pl/docs/en/api/companies/post-companies-companyid-files-attachments): Upload attachment files.
- [Entity Attachments](https://kodasoft.pl/docs/en/api/companies/post-companies-companyid-entity-attachments): Attach files to Opero records.
- [Entity Comments](https://kodasoft.pl/docs/en/api/companies/get-companies-companyid-entity-comments-entitytype-entityid): Read and manage record comments.

## Machine-Readable References

- [OpenAPI schema](https://opero.kodasoft.pl/api/swagger/v1/json): Current external API contract.
- [Sitemap](https://kodasoft.pl/docs/sitemap.xml): Complete public docs URL list.
- [Search index](https://kodasoft.pl/docs/static.json): Public structured search index with page titles, descriptions, and content excerpts.
